# Typewriter on Windows

A minimalist Markdown editor. Formatting renders *as you type*, and the syntax appears only where your cursor is. Here is some **bold text** and a [link](https://example.com).

## Checklist

- [x] Live preview
- [x] Math and diagrams
- [ ] Your next great idea

> Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

## Math

The Gaussian integral: $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}$

| Feature | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Source mode | Ctrl+/ |
| Focus mode | F8 |

const greeting = 'Hello, Windows!';
